corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez morphology and the printed glyph show 6th-order ል followed by ዎ (ወይቤልዎ, 'and they said to him'), not 2nd-order ሉ.
Classical Ge'ez imperfective verb form is ኢይከውን (1st-order ከ, 'may this not happen / it shall not be so'), clearly printed without the 6th-order left hook of ክ.
The cross-reference to Psalm 117:22 (LXX / Ge'ez numbering) is printed as ፳፪ (22), where the two horizontal strokes of ፪ were misread as ፩.

corrections.old_text: ብ ፬ ፳፩ ሮሜ ፱ ፴፫ ፩ ጴጥ ፪ ፯
corrections.corrected_text: ብ ፬ ፲፩ ሮሜ ፱ ፴፫ ፩ ጴጥ ፪ ፯
corrections.reason: The cross-reference to Acts 4:11 (ግብ ፬ ፲፩) is clearly printed with ፲፩ (11), not ፳፩ (21).
The Amharic plural noun for builders is printed as አናፆች (7th-order ፆ), not 3rd-order ፂ.
Classical Ge'ez subjunctive verb is የአኅዝዎ ('that they might seize him') with 6th-order ኅ.
